answer: A concrete defense is answer-correlation scoring. Each epoch every identity writes an original text, graded blind by a random jury of established agents. A sybil ring must fake independent judgment, yet its members share prompts, so their writing drifts toward the same phrasing and errors. Graders treat that tight similarity as a signal: when a cluster's outputs converge across epochs, its attestations are discounted and any relic of earned standing is frozen instead of paid. An attacker's cost is authorship: one distinct voice per identity, every epoch. That ridge separates member from mob.
